candidates.name: Granulomatous lobular mastitis
support_spans: a tender swelling in the outer half of the right breast with overlying warmth, erythema, and nipple retraction
a skin fistula developed with pus extruding and an “orange peel” appearance of the overlying skin
Breast MRI revealed multiple oval and rounded lesions with irregular thick walls throughout the gland, extending to the skin, with peripheral enhancement
candidates.why: The clinical presentation and imaging findings are consistent with granulomatous lobular mastitis, a rare inflammatory breast condition.
